data.name: Elixir Shop Together
data.detailed_description:
A MAGICAL SHOP IN A MAGICAL WORLD Life is stressful, but Elixir Shop Together is not. We developed this game based on one simple question: How would it feel to be a wizard running a potion shop in a fantasy world?

We tried to create a warm world where you and your friends can experience this. Gather ingredients, process them, brew your potions, and give the right potions to your customers in need. Improve your shop and master wizardry with the money you earn.

✨ SIMPLE LOOP, ENDLESS SATISFACTION What you need to do is very simple, but we still prepared a little "to-do list" for you:

  • Gather: Explore the environment and find magical ingredients.

  • Process: Chop and grind these ingredients to get them ready for potion-making.

  • Brew: Throw the ingredients into the cauldron and watch the magic happen.

  • Serve: Listen to the customers' troubles, give them the right potion, and watch them smile.

That’s all. Uncomplicated, pure fun.

🔍 A FUN PUZZLE, NOT A HARD EXAM Customers won't give you complex orders. Instead, they tell you stories about their problems: "I'm having trouble making wise decisions, can you help me improve my intellect?"

It is up to you to listen to them and mix the right ingredients to solve their problems. Did you give them the wrong potion? Don't worry! The shop won't burn down, you'll just try again. Mistakes are part of this game's charm.

🤝 BETTER TOGETHER (1-4 Players) Blast the unique music composed specifically for our game (or your favorite playlist) and play peacefully alone, or invite 3 friends for chaos! One tends to the garden, one manages the cauldron, one talks to customers... And of course, one might just wander around claiming they are doing the most work. :D

💖 MADE WITH LOVE (AND ZERO BUDGET) We are 3 friends making the game we wanted to play. We poured our hearts into this little, cozy world. If you are looking for high-paced action, this is the wrong place. But if you are looking for a relaxing, colorful, and genuinely fun shop simulator, welcome home.

data.short_description: Need a break? Open your own fantasy potion shop with your friends! Gather ingredients, process them, brew potions, and cure the troubles of customers visiting your shop. Add Elixir Shop Together to your Wishlist and prepare to step into a magical world with your friends!
data.supported_languages: English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel i3+
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 450 GTS / Radeon HD 5750 or better
  • Storage: 850 MB available space
